description: Demolition of existing boiler shed. Erection of two storey side and rear extensions and single storey side/rear extension (Minor material amendment to approved planning permission PA25/0982 comprising ground floor changes to roof form of extension from pitched to flat; and aligning rear extension to sit flush with existing rear outrigger, resulting in a footprint increase of 1sqm. Changes to rear ground floor fenestration of approved side extension combined with existing rear elevation to insert a bi-fold door)
decision_conditions:
The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.
REASON: To conform with the requirements of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 as amended by the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.
